contracts.label: eq:self-square

proof.reason: No unequal result exists under the declared real semantics (Z3 UNSAT)
proof.scope: Real denotations over declared intervals; not IEEE floating-point equivalence or a Lean certificate

queries.name: nonempty_domain
queries.smt2:
; benchmark generated from python API
(set-info :status unknown)
(declare-fun a () Real)
(declare-fun b () Real)
(assert
 (<= (- 10.0) a))
(assert
 (>= 10.0 a))
(assert
 (<= (- 10.0) b))
(assert
 (>= 10.0 b))
(check-sat)

queries.name: totality
queries.smt2:
; benchmark generated from python API
(set-info :status unknown)
(declare-fun a () Real)
(declare-fun b () Real)
(assert
 (<= (- 10.0) a))
(assert
 (>= 10.0 a))
(assert
 (<= (- 10.0) b))
(assert
 (>= 10.0 b))
(assert
 (not and))
(check-sat)

queries.name: equivalence
queries.smt2:
; benchmark generated from python API
(set-info :status unknown)
(declare-fun a () Real)
(declare-fun b () Real)
(assert
 (<= (- 10.0) a))
(assert
 (>= 10.0 a))
(assert
 (<= (- 10.0) b))
(assert
 (>= 10.0 b))
(assert
 (let ((?x13 (- a b)))
(let ((?x16 (* ?x13 ?x13)))
(let ((?x15 (^ ?x13 2.0)))
(and (distinct ?x15 ?x16) true)))))
(check-sat)

execution.reference_semantics: exact rational arithmetic on binary input values
execution.execution_scope: validated target function extracted from source; module and external callers are not executed

contracts.minimal_code:
def self_squared_error_lowered(a, b):
    return ((a - b) * (a - b))
contracts.code_pseudocode:
inputs a, b
t_0 <- (a - b)
t_1 <- (t_0 * t_0)
return t_1
contracts.equation_pseudocode:
inputs a, b
t_0 <- (a - b)
t_1 <- (t_0 ** 2)
return t_1
